sqlquery.from:
(select distinct (coalesce(mu.firstname,'') ||' '|| coalesce(mu.lastname,'')) as fullname,pi.projectinvolved,ti.taskinvolved,ts.totaltime, coalesce(CAST(to_char((tc.totalcompleted/ti.taskinvolved),'990.99') AS real),0) as percent from "$".myuser mu left join (select te.employeeid,count(pe.id) as projectinvolved from "$".teamemployee te left join "$".projectemployee pe on pe.employeedepartmentid = te.id where te.isdeleted is not true and pe.isdeleted is not true group by te.employeeid) pi on mu.id = pi.employeeid left join (select te.employeeid,count(emtk.id) as taskinvolved from "$".teamemployee te left join "$".projectemployee pe on pe.employeedepartmentid = te.id left join "$".employeetask emtk on pe.id = emtk.projectemployeeid where te.isdeleted is not true and pe.isdeleted is not true group by te.employeeid ) ti on mu.id=ti.employeeid left join (select te.employeeid,sum(timesheet.timespent) as totaltime from "$".teamemployee te left join "$".projectemployee pe on pe.employeedepartmentid = te.id left join "$".employeetask emtk on pe.id = emtk.projectemployeeid left join "$".timesheet timesheet on emtk.taskid = timesheet.taskid where te.isdeleted is not true and pe.isdeleted is not true group by te.employeeid ) ts on mu.id=ts.employeeid left join (select te.employeeid,sum(task.percent) as totalcompleted from "$".teamemployee te left join "$".projectemployee pe on pe.employeedepartmentid = te.id left join "$".employeetask emtk on pe.id = emtk.projectemployeeid left join "$".task task on emtk.taskid = task.id where te.isdeleted is not true and pe.isdeleted is not true group by te.employeeid ) tc on mu.id=tc.employeeid
where mu.deleted is not true and mu.active is true ) t
